recommendation: Keep this audit commit for the core reconciliation. If PA finalizes FHIR-52121 or another future large-result policy, update the Administrative Incubator Patient $everything source rather than reintroducing a core OperationDefinition.
issue_request: FHIR-44604 was Applied/Persuasive for PA and requested removing Patient $everything wording that said, unless the client requests otherwise, the server returns the entire result set in a single Bundle rather than using paging. The approved replacement condensed the local difference statement to the included-resource rationale and required applying FHIR-43373 first.
initial_application: Core commit 8085536f12e251d00b80ac47323658eb94e9b1ac applied FHIR-44604 together with FHIR-43373 to source/patient/operationdefinition-Patient-everything.xml, removing the single-Bundle bullet and deleting the copied OperationDefinition comment. Commit e8524f5b6b54904776987148319de565a582b52d later removed the duplicate Patient footer sentence introduced by that first application while aligning Encounter/EpisodeOfCare.
additional_context: Commit b487fdda4bb4a5382a93dbb5a811efd02425b9bc removed Patient-everything from the core Patient operations list and changed core references to the Administrative Incubator continuous build. Current core source therefore has only external links to Patient $everything, and the current HL7/admin-incubator OperationDefinition source contains the approved key-difference sentence without the removed single-Bundle requirement. Later FHIR-52121 and Zulip/Confluence discussions may further revise large-result handling, but FHIR-52121 is Triaged and not final Applied/Published scope for this run.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No core source hunk was necessary because the authoritative current operation source is outside this checkout and already reflects the seed issue.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-44604 explicitly depended on this Patient $everything cleanup and both were applied in the same core commit; not separately decided because its Provenance/AuditEvent and US Core wording scope is broader than the seed.
This later Applied issue aligned Encounter/EpisodeOfCare with the Patient changes and removed the duplicated Patient footer sentence; not separately decided because it concerns distinct artifacts.
Later large-result handling discussion for Patient $everything, but still Triaged and not final source-edit scope for this reconciliation.
